decision: Each decision record states one constraint plainly.
why: Without this, goal-shaped entries pass review but give no signal when the system drifts.

links.note: The graph's link rules only hold when entries are well-formed — a link note cannot express a meaningful constraint if the source entry conflates multiple decisions.

violations: Decision statement that describes a goal rather than a constraint.
Why field that does not describe the consequence of ignoring the decision.
Multiple decisions collapsed into a single entry.
